name: llm-gw
changelog:
v4: token stats and cost count the Responses API (/v1/responses: input_tokens/output_tokens) as well as Chat Completions — the agent template talks to GPT-5/o-series models over it to show their reasoning
v3: response helpers come from the SDK (xbin.WriteJSON/WriteError)
v2: net:internet egress grant so upstream calls work under isolation
title: LLM Gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy. Configure a provider base URL, upstream token, and model aliases once; other tiles get a grant to call /v1/* (chat, embeddings, …) exactly like the OpenAI API. Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, etc.
